quote: Document every exported function in Visual Studio Code and add each one to the API index, with a thousand agents.

say: A thousand agents start, each on its own files. Each also writes one line in a shared index, so they collide thousands of times, and every collision is redone on the newest code. A hundred and sixty-six files were rejected by the checks and left unchanged; the rest land on main.
The run's own page: the index check, five thousand eight hundred seventy-three lines, none missing; and the collisions chart: every collision met was redone.
